earnings.title: Bunge Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Q3 GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations of $1.64 vs. $0.86 in the prior year; $2.56 vs. $2.27 on an adjusted basis excluding certain gains/charges and mark-to-market timing differences
outlook: Maintaining full-year adjusted EPS outlook range of $9.25 to $9.75
